title: Engineering Manager - Delivery Experience Backend Team
company: Allegro sp. z o.o.
required_skills: Java .NET Team management Team Leadership Software development Architecture Angielski (B2) Polski (B2)
requirements: Oryginalny tekst. Pokaż tłumaczenie Are you excited about making a big impact in the e-commerce logistics sector? Allegro's Delivery Experience area is searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager to lead our backend team. You will be leading an existing team of 4 people, including backend engineers and testers. Here's why you should join us: Strategic Transformation: Lead the evolution of a critical integration platform, including the migration of selected services from .NET/Azure to Allegro’s strategic JVM and GCP stack. High-Impact Domain: Work at the core of our logistics and integration ecosystem. Your team's services are the foundational layer for our carrier platform strategy, significantly reducing cross-team dependencies and drastically cutting down carrier onboarding time. Innovative Integrations: Manage and develop key APIs for our delivery network, enabling external partners to seamlessly integrate with our infrastructure (such as our parcel lockers). You will also oversee hybrid integrations that connect multiple carriers, shaping the future of our delivery ecosystem. Business & Tech Synergy: Play a crucial role in bridging the gap between business and technology. You will translate complex business expectations into technical solutions and confidently represent Allegro in technical discussions with external partners. We are looking for people who: Have a strong technical background in backend development (.NET or Java) and are enthusiastic about leading a technology transformation towards the JVM ecosystem. Have experience in planning, managing, and executing complex system migrations or architectural overhauls. Possess strong business acumen and can comfortably translate high-level business needs into actionable technical tasks. Are excellent communicators, confident in representing the team externally and acting as a trusted partner in technical discussions. Are willing to be hands-on when necessary. Have a product-oriented mindset with proven experience in maintaining and scaling critical APIs. Are fluent in both Polish and English (B2 level).
offer_description: Oryginalny tekst. Pokaż tłumaczenie Important things for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work. Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer: Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results. Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units). Our team is based in Warsaw. What’s in it for you: Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms). A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories. A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers). English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job. A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA. You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create. You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support). You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers. You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about! Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!
responsibilities: Oryginalny tekst. Pokaż tłumaczenie Planning and executing the strategic migration of microservices from .NET to JVM/Kotlin/GCP without disrupting ongoing operations. Managing, mentoring, and supporting a focused backend engineering team, guiding them smoothly through a major technology stack transition. Maintaining existing integration APIs and developing new features to support incoming carriers and new business requests. Acting as a translator between business stakeholders and the engineering team, ensuring technical deliverables align with business expectations. Leading technical discussions and negotiations with business partners. Supporting the team in daily operations, including participating in on-call duties and providing hands-on technical guidance.

title: Engineering Manager (fixed term contract)
company: Auctane Poland Sp. z o.o.
required_skills: AWS API Object-oriented programming Cloud C# .NET Java Python Polski (Biegły) Angielski (B2)
nice_to_have: TypeScript JavaScript Ansible Terraform Domain-driven design
requirements: Oryginalny tekst. Pokaż tłumaczenie About us At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe. The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart. About the role As an Engineering Manager, you will have a significant impact on your team's operations. You will continuously enhance tools and processes for people management while collaborating with engineering managers to define new workflows and implement improvements. At Auctane, we value professionals at every stage of their career journey. When applying for this position, please note that we'll assess your profile and skills based on your experience level—whether junior, intermediate, or senior. Our goal is to build a diverse and complementary team that brings together different perspectives and levels of expertise. If you're excited to contribute to a newly formed team, we'd love to hear from you! Please note this is a fixed-term contract position based in Zielona Gora. What are we looking for? As a trusted technical authority, you will become the primary point of contact for all engineering-related matters. Extensive experience in designing, building, and deploying solutions in AWS with an unwavering focus on quality. Comprehensive expertise in designing and delivering low-latency, high-throughput API systems using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles. As a programming polyglot, you excel in delivering software systems while leveraging Agile, Lean, and DevOps methodologies, effectively leading project execution. Writing automated tests (unit, integration, etc.), pairing, enhancing code quality, and continuous integration are embedded in your professional DNA. Proven experience in at least one object-oriented programming language, framework, or development platform. Experienced in developing CI/CD solutions and cloud infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet. You believe that neglecting Continuous Delivery is a missed opportunity to learn and deliver value to clients. Passionate about full team ownership, encompassing the entire product lifecycle and its components, including code, infrastructure, and after-hours support. Embracing a new programming language or technology is an opportunity you eagerly pursue. Skilled at balancing the demands of delivering high-quality products while meeting challenging deadlines and committed to fulfilling your responsibilities. Your actions consistently demonstrate that collaboration is the best path to delivering outstanding products.

We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated. Volunteer day. You can take 1 day off per year in order to participate in volunteering activities! We will love to see some pictures in our slack! Referral Fee 🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! An inclusive and upbeat work environment Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive. A cross-cultural atmosphere We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Internal and external training, free access to online training platforms such as Linkedin Learning Possibility to work in a home-office using equipment provided by AUCTANE, or in our office prepared in accordance with all safety requirements. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.
